points.description: States that the connection must allow two-way (full-duplex or semi-duplex) communication between sender and receiver, so that data frames can travel in both directions and acknowledgements can ride on frames going the other way. Equivalent wording also earns the mark, and so does stating that frames must carry an extra acknowledgement field.

rubric.notes: The model answer gives one requirement, with two accepted phrasings: a two-way (full or semi-duplex) link, or frames that include an acknowledgement field. Award the full mark if the student gives either one in their own words. A vague answer such as "it needs acknowledgements" with no link to two-way transmission or an ack field earns no mark.
